gerenciador.eachDepartmentSQueueWith: Each department's queue, with the schedule, who is working and the measured time.

gerenciador.noTimeLoggedInThis: No time logged in this block.

produtividade.completedTasksSoldTimeComes: Completed tasks. Sold time comes from the build-up; logged time, from the clock. Productivity = sold ÷ logged.

produtividade.theSoldTimeSplitIn: The sold time split in proportion to the time each person worked on the task. It's meant to calibrate the estimate and the bonus, not to rank people.
produtividade.noCompletedTasksWithLogged: No completed tasks with logged time yet.
produtividade.timeWithNoSaleMaintenance: Time with no sale (maintenance, cleaning, rework) isn't counted here (GP-34).
produtividade.productivityPerPersonIsVisible: Productivity per person is visible to whoever edits production (manager).
produtividade.youDonTHavePermission: You don't have permission to view productivity.
produtividade.comparesTheTimePlannedIn: Compares the time planned in the build-up with the actual production time.

projetos.deliveryIsAtRiskWhat: Delivery is at risk: what's left in the chain doesn't fit within the deadline.
projetos.oneForEachStepOf: One for each step of the items' build-up, in the size sold. Finishing waits for the base when its type requires it.
projetos.theFirstPromisedDeadlineStays: The first promised deadline stays on record. The production chain is checked again against the new date.
projetos.theProjectIsCreatedWhen: The project is created when the sale is approved: one task for each step of the items' build-up.
projetos.theProjectIsCreatedWhen2: The project is created when the sale is approved.
